narratives.UserStory: As a hooks maintainer, I want expanded fixture matrix coverage and decision-code docs, so that host edge bugs land as fixtures and stable codes instead of one-off matcher patches.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: Step 1: Expand packages/core/src/hooks/fixtures/cases.ts matrix cases. Step 2: Share fixture load path in packages/cli/src/hook-dispatch.test.ts and dispatcher.test.ts. Step 3: Document decision codes in packages/core/src/hooks/fixtures/README.md. Step 4: CHANGELOG.md Phase B of #2950. Verify with vitest on hooks fixtures and hook-dispatch tests. drive-to: merge-ready. CHANGELOG.md may be edited last with unique Unreleased bullets (shared non-exclusive).

narrative.Acceptance: Given the expanded fixtures corpus, cases.test.ts returns pass for additional Cursor win32 and posix Write and ApplyPatch cases.
When hook-dispatch.test.ts runs, it imports at least one fixture case from packages/core/src/hooks/fixtures and the test returns pass.
Given fixtures/README.md is opened, it records stable decision codes agents may depend on for permission outcomes.
When CHANGELOG.md is opened, it records an Unreleased entry that cites Phase B of #2950.
